svg.title: Keep weights and KV distinct from per-step input/output
svg.desc: Inherited tiny FP64 model: 720 weight bytes; prompt [1]; three selected IDs [2,2,2]
svg.text: Keep weights and KV distinct from per-step input/output
Inherited tiny FP64 model: 720 weight bytes; prompt [1]; three selected IDs [2,2,2]
Upload admitted weights once, then reuse on device
Two blocks read the same versioned parameter collection for every forward.
Resident weights still incur device-side reads; payload storage is not DRAM traffic.
Prefill → decode 1 → decode 2; no terminal extra forward
Process positions 0,1,2; completed valid KV grows 64 → 128 → 192 bytes.
Activations and scratch have their own last uses; do not add aliases as new storage.
CPU selection: send inputs, read full last-position logits
Three four-byte input IDs H2D; three 32-byte vocabulary rows D2H.
Resident-request payload: 12 + 96 = 108 bytes; initial weights are separate.
GPU selection: keep the next input local, return selected IDs
Prompt H2D: 4 bytes. Three selected IDs D2H: 12 bytes.
Resident-request payload: 16 bytes; preserve tie, EOS, stopping and control dependencies.
108/16 = 6.75 is a payload ratio. Correct output and completed timing are separate gates.
